title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
description: The application reflected user-controlled input directly into the HTTP response without output encoding.
impact: An attacker could potentially execute JavaScript in a victim's browser when the victim visits a crafted URL.
rootCause: User-controlled input was rendered without appropriate output encoding.
evidence: The payload <script>alert(document.domain)</script> was reflected directly in the HTTP response.
remediation: Apply context-appropriate output encoding before rendering user-controlled input. Implement a restrictive Content Security Policy as defense in depth.
retestResult: After remediation, the payload was HTML-encoded and JavaScript execution did not occur.

title: Missing Security Headers
description: Recommended security headers are missing from the HTTP response.
impact: Missing security headers can increase exposure to browser-based attacks.
evidence: HTTP response did not contain several recommended security headers.

title: Missing Content Security Policy
description: Content Security Policy header was not observed in the HTTP response.
impact: Absence of a restrictive CSP may increase the impact of certain client-side injection
rootCause: Security response headers were not fully configured.
evidence: The HTTP response did not contain a Content-Security-Policy header.
remediation: Implement an appropriate restrictive Content-Security-Policy header.
